about.title: About Us
about.description: Loadly is a logistics and freight content platform, publishing practical guides and industry insights in 55 languages for shippers, carriers, and logistics professionals worldwide.
about.fastEasyDesc: Find clear answers on freight costs, routes, and regulations in minutes — no digging through scattered sources.
about.reliableDesc: Every guide is researched and reviewed before publishing, drawing on established industry sources and data.
about.wideDesc: In-depth logistics coverage spanning Turkey, Europe, the Middle East, and beyond — published in 55 languages.
about.visionP1: By making reliable, practical logistics knowledge accessible in every major language, we aim to help shippers, carriers, and logistics professionals everywhere make better-informed decisions.
about.visionP2: We continue to expand our library of guides and analysis — covering freight costs, routes, and regulatory changes — so our readers always have access to current, accurate information.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.description: You can always contact us for your questions, comments, or suggestions. Our team will get back to you as soon as possible.
contact.quickSupportDesc: We recommend using our email channel for your urgent support needs regarding advertising opportunities, collaborations, or account management. We return within 24 hours at the latest.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.description: A detailed, cookie-by-cookie breakdown of what Loadly and its third-party providers store in your browser, and why.
cookiePolicy.introDesc: Cookies are small text files stored in your browser when you visit a website. They let a site remember your preferences, keep you signed in, and — where you've consented — measure traffic and show relevant ads. This page lists, individually, every category of cookie Loadly and its providers use. For how we handle the personal data cookies may touch, see our Privacy Policy.

rows.name: NEXT_LOCALE
rows.purpose: Remembers your selected display language so you don't have to re-select it on every page.
rows.duration: Session (cleared when you close your browser)

rows.name: cookie-consent
rows.purpose: Stores your cookie consent choice (accepted or declined) so we don't ask again on every visit. Stored in local storage, not a traditional cookie.
rows.duration: Persistent, until you clear your browser's site data

rows.name: sb-access-token / sb-refresh-token
rows.purpose: Keeps you signed in to your Loadly account between page loads.
rows.duration: Session, up to 7 days for the refresh token
rows.provider: Supabase, on Loadly's behalf (first-party, strictly necessary)

rows.name: _ga, _gid
rows.purpose: Distinguish and count unique visitors for aggregate traffic analytics. Only set once you accept cookies.

rows.name: IDE, test_cookie, and related advertising cookies
rows.purpose: Used by Google AdSense/DoubleClick to serve ads and measure ad performance based on your visits to this and other sites. Only set once you accept cookies.
rows.duration: Varies by cookie, typically up to 13 months

cookiePolicy.rowsNote: Google controls the exact list and lifetime of its own analytics and advertising cookies, and these can change without notice on our end — see Google's own cookie documentation for the current, authoritative list.
cookiePolicy.manageDesc: You can accept or decline non-essential (analytics/advertising) cookies from the consent banner shown on your first visit, or change your choice at any time by clearing your browser's site data for loadlyapp.com. You can also opt out of personalized advertising directly with Google:
cookiePolicy.browserDesc: Every modern browser lets you block or delete cookies from its settings. Note that blocking strictly-necessary cookies (like NEXT_LOCALE or the sign-in cookies) may stop parts of Loadly — like staying signed in — from working correctly.
cookiePolicy.contactDesc: If you have questions about this Cookie Policy, contact us at:

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.disclaimer: Loadly is only a classifieds platform. The platform does not establish any brokerage, contract, or commercial relationship between shippers and carriers. Transportation, payment, and damage obligations are directly between the listing owner and the carrier. The platform accepts no liability arising from these obligations.
privacy.overviewDesc: Loadly values the privacy of its users. This privacy policy explains how personal data collected, used, and protected through the Loadly platform is processed. By using the platform, you agree to the conditions stated in this policy.
privacy.dataDesc: The Loadly platform collects the following data:
privacy.dataL1: Account information: Full name, email address, phone number, company name (optional), user role (shipper/driver)
privacy.dataL2: Listing data: Created load listings, route information, date and location information
privacy.dataL3: Communication data: Messages sent via the platform and conversation history
privacy.dataL4: Technical data: IP address, browser type, device information, access times
privacy.dataL5: Usage data: Platform interaction data, feature usage statistics
privacy.dataNote: Loadly does not process payment information or contract data. No payment transactions occur through the platform.
privacy.useDesc: Collected personal data is used for the following purposes:
privacy.useL2: Providing services for creating, publishing, and managing listings
privacy.useL3: Providing messaging and communication capabilities between users
privacy.useL4: Operating route matching and load-driver matching features
privacy.useL5: Ensuring platform security, preventing fraud and abuse
privacy.useL7: Monitoring platform performance and improving user experience
privacy.useNote: Loadly does not use your personal data for payment processing purposes. No payment transactions occur through the platform.
privacy.cookiesDesc: The Loadly platform uses cookies to improve user experience and ensure the platform operates correctly. Cookie types used:
privacy.cookiesL1: Session cookies: Maintaining login status and ensuring account security
privacy.cookiesL2: Technical cookies: Cookies necessary for the platform to function properly
privacy.cookiesL3: Analytical cookies: Analyzing and improving platform usage
privacy.cookiesNote: You can disable cookies from your browser settings; however, in this case, some features of the platform may not work properly.
privacy.cookiesAdDesc: Loadly may display advertisements served by Google AdSense and other third-party ad networks. These providers use cookies (including the Google DoubleClick DART cookie) to serve ads based on your visits to this and other websites, and to measure ad performance.
privacy.cookiesAdNote: You can manage or opt out of personalized advertising at any time using the links below:
privacy.cookiePolicyLinkText: See the full cookie-by-cookie breakdown in our Cookie Policy.
privacy.thirdPartiesDesc: Your personal data may be shared with third parties in the following cases:
privacy.thirdPartiesL1: Service providers providing the technical infrastructure of the platform (hosting, database services)
privacy.thirdPartiesL2: Authorized public institutions: In line with legal obligations and legal requests
privacy.thirdPartiesL3: Legal advisors: For the purpose of resolving legal disputes
privacy.thirdPartiesNote: Loadly does not share your personal data with payment providers. No payment transactions occur through the platform.
privacy.securityDesc: Loadly takes all necessary technical and administrative measures to ensure the security of your personal data. Your data is protected by encryption methods, and firewalls and access controls are implemented against unauthorized access. The platform conducts regular security tests and assessments to prevent vulnerabilities. However, no data transmission over the internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure.
privacy.rightsDesc: Under GDPR/KVKK, you have the following rights:
privacy.rightsL1: Accessing and viewing your personal data
privacy.rightsL2: Requesting the correction of your inaccurate or incomplete data
privacy.rightsL3: Requesting the deletion of your personal data
privacy.rightsL4: Objecting to the processing of your data
privacy.rightsL5: Requesting the transfer of your data
privacy.rightsL6: Limiting the transfer of your data to third parties
privacy.rightsNote: You can apply via kvkk@loadlyapp.com to exercise these rights.
privacy.changesDesc: Loadly reserves the right to update this privacy policy in accordance with legal requirements or changes in platform features. Policy changes will be published on the platform, and the update date will be revised. It is recommended that you check this page regularly to stay informed of changes. By continuing to use the platform, you agree to the updated policy.
privacy.ccpaDesc: If you are a California resident, you have additional rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA):
privacy.ccpaL1: The right to know what personal information we collect and how it is used
privacy.ccpaL2: The right to request deletion of your personal information
privacy.ccpaL3: The right to opt out of the "sale" or "sharing" of your personal information — a term that, under CCPA, can include allowing third-party ad providers like Google AdSense to use identifiers for personalized advertising
privacy.ccpaNote: To exercise any of these rights, email kvkk@loadlyapp.com with the subject "California Privacy Request". You can also opt out of personalized advertising directly via the Google Ads Settings link above.
privacy.contactDesc: If you have questions or concerns about the privacy policy, you can contact us through the following channels:
privacy.dataL6: Mobile app (Android) data: if you grant location permission, your device location is used on-device (via Android Geocoder) to determine your country and subscribe you to that country's push-notification topic via Firebase Cloud Messaging — raw coordinates are never sent to or stored on Loadly's own servers. The app also holds a Firebase push-notification registration token (needed to deliver notifications to your device) and, if you accept ads, an advertising identifier used by Google AdMob.
